'''House Haevin''' is one of the 19 Major [[:Category:Noble houses|Noble houses]] of [[Andor]]. Its current [[High Seat]] is [[Catalyn Haevin]]. Haevins are known for their acid tongues, and even take pride in that fact.{{ref/book|10|13}}

==Members==
*[[Catalyn Haevin]] (High Seat)
*[[Arendor Haevin]]

==House Sigil==
The sigil of House Haevin is the blue bear.{{ref/book|10|13}}

==Activities==
'''[[Succession Wars|Fourth Succession War]]''' - House Haevin (along [[House Taravin]], [[House Gilyard]], [[House Mantear]], and [[House Northan]]) was one of the first five Houses to lend its support to [[House Trakand]] in its claim for the [[Lion Throne]]{{ref/book|10|13}}.
